nodes.label: W-247 — R3's twenty-one items every one disposed
nodes.rationale: M: 'so don't tell me R3 is finished until it is.' W-246's heading called R3 complete while five items stood open, and four of the five were governed by rulings already in force.

nodes.label: A6 — 'not a lattice' repaired to 'not a sublattice of the product'
nodes.rationale: The evidence offered is componentwise in every case — a componentwise minimum falling outside the set — which is a sublattice statement, not a lattice one; the chapter proves it on its own next paragraph, where the meet-broken triangle region IS a lattice. It never needed the five presentations rebuilt.

nodes.label: A8 — composability peaks at Λ₁₀, and only the evidence falls
nodes.rationale: Pairings determined by which ones reproduce the compendium's own fractions: four of six exactly, with Λ₁₁ and Λ₁₃ reproducing under no pairing an exhaustive sweep tried, reported rather than smoothed. Register 314's claim is untouched — this is the item most easily over-repaired, and repairing the headline would delete a result that stands.

nodes.label: A5 — the constraint graph measured and scoped
nodes.rationale: Treewidth is 1 at Λ₈ and Λ₉ so ℛ closes those stages exactly, which falsifies the caption's 'shortfall of one level holds for the whole tower' two lines below its own cycle-rank sequence. A fifth caption error is found that 1790 did not record, because 1790 was measuring Λ₁₃. A5 is scoped by a seated entry rather than blocked by a missing ruling.

nodes.label: Never withdraw a recorded finding on reconstructed evidence
nodes.rationale: When a reconstruction disagrees with the record the finding is about the reconstruction. B3 is refused because the original instrument is not held and the correction is chat-witnessed; B7 because the seated instrument contradicts the correction outright. Both are closed by rules already in force, and neither is a missing ruling.
